description: This file contains internal utility functions primarily related to diagnostics and status reporting for the OpenClaw Android app. It includes functions for generating version labels, interpreting gateway statuses, and building/sharing diagnostic reports for troubleshooting connection issues.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns the app version label, appending '-dev' if in debug mode and version name is not already marked as development.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the gateway status text, defaulting to 'Offline' if empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Determines whether the gateway status indicates an issue other than offline or connecting.

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Checks if the gateway status suggests pairing or approval process.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Constructs a detailed diagnostics report string with device info, app version, gateway address, and status text.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the diagnostics report to clipboard and shows a toast notification.
